body_evidence.label: Hand across the body at release

explanation.basis: Compared with this athlete's 19 other analysed throws (same method version).
evidence: The slide (it moved 11 in right after landing).
explanation.observed: Ended off the board, 2 in long and 17 in right of the hole. First contact 4 in short of the usual spot.
explanation.possible_explanation: The difference arose after landing (the slide), not in the flight; no release measure accounts for a single throw's slide.
explanation.suggestion: Watch the landing in the side view (bag flat or on edge, spin) and compare with throws that stayed.

attribution.sentence: Off the board: 2 in long, 17 in right. Most of the right came from the slide (it moved 11 in right after landing).

lateral.note: Left/right measured by the front camera on the deck (about ±0.3 in).

slide.reason: Effective kinetic friction for a bag sliding up the deck, from a constant-deceleration fit. Fitted on the plain deck before the hole.

suggested_outcome.basis: front camera (looking straight at the hole)

camera.source: session median of the deck-shape field of view

flight_3d.frame: x along the throw from the release point (m), y sideways from the board's centre line (m, + thrower's right), z height above the floor (m); t from release (s, side camera clock)
flight_3d.reason: The side camera's bag flight was not accepted, so the flight along the throw and its height are not known.

front_kinematics.time_zero: release (side camera, mapped to the front clip)

arm_across_body_sw.label: Hand across the body at release (+ towards the midline)

follow_through_across_sw.label: Hand across the body 0.15 s after release (+ towards the midline)

hand_path_range_sw.label: Hand path sideways range in the forward swing (front view 2D)
hand_path_range_sw.reason: The hand was partly hidden behind the body in 27% of the forward swing (pose confidence below 0.5), so part of the path is the model's guess.

release_point_offset_m.label: Release hand's distance from the board's centre line (+ thrower's right)

shoulder_tilt_deg.label: Shoulder tilt at release (+ throwing shoulder lower)

stance_offset_m.label: Feet midpoint from the board's centre line 1 s before release (+ thrower's right)

trunk_lean_change_deg.label: Trunk side lean change from set-up to release (+ towards throwing arm, front view 2D)

trunk_side_lean_deg.label: Trunk side lean at release (+ towards throwing arm)

notes: This throw's release distance was not measured; the athlete's median of the other throws (5.31 m) is used for the aim, which is therefore estimated.
